description: Global sourcing consultancy connecting NZ/AU businesses with verified industrial manufacturers across Asia

primary.name: Primary Brand Color - Slate Blue
primary.description: Core brand color - desaturated slate-blue carrying nearly all UI weight

secondary.name: Secondary Brand Color - Bronze/Copper
secondary.description: Muted accent - reserved for single CTAs, eyebrows, and small emphasis marks

accent.name: Accent Color
accent.description: Emphasis color for highlights and interactive elements

display.name: Display Font (Headlines)
display.description: Used for h1, h2, h3 headings and hero sections - crisp corporate style

body.name: Body Font (Text)
body.description: Used for paragraphs, descriptions, and body text - professional services tone

mono.name: Monospace Font (Code)
mono.description: Used for code snippets and technical content

businessVibe.audience: B2B Clients, Manufacturing Companies, Procurement Partners

voiceAndTone.register: Professional-services - measured, specific, trust-building through clarity rather than superlatives
voiceAndTone.casing: Sentence case for body copy and buttons; headline eyebrows uppercase with letter-spacing
voiceAndTone.numbers: Used sparingly and only when concrete - never invented statistics
voiceAndTone.emoji: None - B2B industrial consultancy reads as more credible without them
